gloss: receipts and disbursements; accounting of money

definitions.gloss: receipts and payments; cash accounting; bookkeeping of money
definitions.explanation: The taking in and paying out of money, and the keeping of records of those transactions. Used mainly in accounting and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出納|すいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: To record cash receipts and payments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{出納帳|すいとうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけている→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I keep a cashbook every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{出納|すいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}めて→締める：10057_shimeru⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The accounting staff close the books each month and report the receipts and payments.

notes:
Note the irregular reading: {出|すい} (not しゅつ). From {出|すい} (out) + {納|とう} (take in).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出納帳|すいとうちょう}: cashbook, account book
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧{出納|すいとう}: cash receipts and payments
- {出納|すいとう}{係|がかり}: cashier; teller

NOTE: A fairly formal, accounting-specific term; in everyday speech one would simply say ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (managing money).
